description_en: Removes one or more load balancing instances
description_zh: 移除一个或多个负载均衡实例
kebab_example: aliyun ess detach-load-balancers --scaling-group-id asg-bp1ffogfdauy0jw00000 --load-balancer lb-2zeur05gfs0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachLoadBalancers

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to remove ECS instances that belong to the current scaling group from the backend servers of the load balancing instance after the load balancing instance is removed. Valid values:

true: Removes the ECS instances.

false: Does not remove the ECS instances.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否移除负载均衡实例后端服务器中属于当前伸缩组的ECS实例。取值范围：

true：移除ECS实例。

false：不移除ECS实例。

默认值：false
parameters.name: force_detach

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests.

The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。

只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use asynchronous invocation when removing load balancing instances. Asynchronous invocation ensures the transactional nature of the operation, which means that either all operations execute successfully or none of the operations take effect if one fails. Use asynchronous invocation.

Valid values:

true: Asynchronous invocation. The request returns the ID of the scaling activity.

false: Synchronous call.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
移除负载均衡实例时，是否采用异步调用的方式。异步调用能保证操作的事务性，即所有操作都执行成功或者某个操作失败时所有操作的执行结果都不生效，建议您采用异步调用。

取值范围：

true：异步调用。请求将返回伸缩活动的ID。

false：同步调用。

默认值：false
parameters.name: async

parameters.help_en: The ID of the load balancing instance. You can remove up to five load balancing instances at a time
parameters.help_zh: 负载均衡实例的ID，单次最多支持移除5台负载均衡实例
parameters.name: load_balancer

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id

ScalingActivityId.description_en:
The ID of the scaling activity.

This value is returned only when `Async=true`. You can call the [DescribeScalingActivities]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25961.html） operation to query the returned scaling activity ID and check the execution status of the scaling activity
ScalingActivityId.description_zh:
伸缩活动的ID。

仅当`Async=true`时返回该值。您可使用API [DescribeScalingActivities]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25961.html）遍历查询返回的伸缩活动ID，查看伸缩活动的执行状态
